profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with focus on C/C++, Python, .Net, and JavaScript.
Looking to gain knowledge and experience with other languages.
Experienced with embedded systems, FPGA programming, I2C/SPI/UART communication, and general circuit analysis.
Looking to expand knowledge on hardware/software interaction.

positions.description: Respond and problem solve A/V equipment issues in classrooms.  Setup and support computer systems in CAEN computer labs.
